147-413-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Zombify.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-3897-6754.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-6754.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

856-2267-5776-6495.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
856-2267-5776-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4865-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Vesuvan Shapeshifter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

4067-4188-7890.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
4067-4188-7890.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-4659-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Ironworks ability.
Repeat.
2122-4659-6972.notes: As mana allows, you can activate Mindless Automaton's first ability assuming you have a card in hand to bring it back up to two +1/+1 counters. You can then remove those to draw a card, replacing Krark-Clan Ironworks in that iteration assuming there's no anthem effects boosting Mindless Automaton's toughness.

2457-5794-6441-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

511-817-3129-4050-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-3129-4050-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

862-3558-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-3558-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

549-2685-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-5641-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1409-3099-3755-5434.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1376-4644-7791.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
1376-4644-7791.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Priest of Titania.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

215-2079-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-2079-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4013-4659-5004-6643-7729.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {3}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2086-5231-6996.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

661-1594-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Helm of Awakening. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

703-7149-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Omni-Changeling dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Omni-Changeling enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Omni-Changelings into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Omni-Changeling tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-7149-7193.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7153.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3169-6972-7145.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Sporeback Troll.
3169-6972-7145.description:
Kill Sporeback Troll.
When Sporeback Troll dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Sporeback Troll enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Sporeback Troll triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Sporeback Troll dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-2800-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2800-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2692-2893-3470-4826.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

104-1939-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1939-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Lunarch Veteran or Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain life
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

380-2726-2972-3129.description:
Cast Miirym either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{G}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Miirym spell, creating two token copies of Miirym.
Put all but one legendary Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Miirym spell. Choose to put the nontoken Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Miirym you control and Ganax trigger,
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve a Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Miirym that aren't legendary.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 11 until you control no Treasures and/or you have enough mana to cast Miirym from the command zone.
Repeat from step 1.
380-2726-2972-3129.notes: The starting cost assume you haven't cost Miirym from the command zone this game. You can perform the combo if you've cast Miirym this game from the command zone, but will need additional mana to do so.

2921-3991-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

640-2173-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
640-2173-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

4567-6735.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 22 minus Greven's power, rounded up to the nearest multiple of 2.
4567-6735.description:
Activate Soul Channeling by paying 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until Greven has power 21 or greater due to its first ability.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Greven. The opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage from your commander.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

198-1444-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {G} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Elvish Fury.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

997-4053--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-4053--73.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

222-527-997-1251.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-1251.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

654-3322-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-3322-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-3322-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-3715-4029-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-4029-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

2034-2178-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2034-2178-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

152-2034-4365-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

1527-4231-4911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-4231-4911.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may sacrifice them to their abilities, or tap them via Ghirapur's Aether Grid to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

819-1980-5195-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any creature you control.
819-1980-5195-5243.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

985-2034-3847-4574.notablePrerequisites: Arcbound Worker has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
985-2034-3847-4574.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Worker, adding {C}{C}.
Arcbound Worker dies, triggering its modular ability, moving its +1/+1 counters onto Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Worker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Arcbound Worker from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Arcbound Worker enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2366-3525-4495.notablePrerequisites:
New Horzions and Pemmin's Aura attached to Dryad Arbor.
Dryad Arbor does not have summoning sickness.
2366-3525-4495.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

1300-3525-3993-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other Shrines.
1300-3525-3993-4050.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Life's Web triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Honden of Life's Web's ability.
Resolve the copy of Honden of Life's Web's ability, creating at least three 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar two times by sacrificing two Spirit tokens, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.
